official_measurement_examples.name: European protected species status
official_measurement_examples.fact: Great crested newts, their eggs, breeding sites and resting places are protected by law as a European protected species.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning standing advice
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England's great-crested-newt standing advice is a material planning consideration and was last updated 7 April 2025.

official_measurement_examples.name: A14 and district licensing separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: A14 is the individual mitigation route for otherwise unlawful impacts; district level licensing is a separate strategic alternative where a scheme operates.

official_measurement_examples.name: District licensing risk zones
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England's district scheme permits DLL in amber and green zones but not in red zones, where site survey and mitigation licensing are required.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL33 low-impact scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL33 is restricted to registered consultants and low or temporary impacts, generally for work lasting less than six months; otherwise A14 or DLL is required.

official_measurement_examples.name: CL08 and CL09 survey distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: CL08 permits specified survey methods but not pitfall traps; CL09 permits pitfall traps with notification. Both are survey licences rather than development mitigation permission.

official_measurement_examples.name: Presence-only survey returns
official_measurement_examples.fact: Natural England's class survey returns dataset was updated 29 April 2026 and is explicitly presence-only; its point may be a grid-reference centroid rather than a specific pond.

official_measurement_examples.name: Planning and licensing separation
official_measurement_examples.fact: Protected-species licensing and district licensing do not by themselves establish planning permission, land ownership, species absence or parcel development capacity.

core_rules: great-crested-newt protection law is not proof newts are present on a parcel
great-crested-newt survey result is not planning permission
planning permission is not an A14 mitigation licence
A14 mitigation licensing is distinct from district level licensing
CL33 low-impact registration is not general development clearance
CL08 survey authority is not mitigation authority
CL09 pitfall-trap survey authority is not mitigation authority
district-level risk zones are strategic modelled evidence not parcel presence or absence
red amber and green risk-zone rules must retain their scheme-specific meaning
historic newt survey evidence must retain its date season methods and spatial scope
presence-only licence-return data cannot establish species absence
planning standing advice is not a planning decision
protected-species licensing does not determine land ownership
district-level compensation does not reserve development capacity or access rights
no parcel great-crested-newt clearance or Future Growth score may be promoted while recovery is parked
